name: Canadian North Resources Inc.
summary: Canadian North Resources Inc. explores and develops mineral resources, seeking cobalt, copper and nickel as critical minerals as well as platinum group metals including palladium, platinum and rhodium. The wholly owned Ferguson Lake property in Nunavut's Kivalliq Region, which consists of ten adjoining mining leases, is its key asset. Dating from 2013, it is headquartered in Mississauga, Canada.
